newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - Feb 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Monday:
WASHINGTON - Researcher for the first time have cloned an adult mammal, a controversial feat that could presage the ability to clone human beings.
MOSCOW - Yuri Luzhkov, the vigorous, bullying, populist mayor of Moscow, is marshaling a new kind of capitalism -- state capitalism -- onto the Russian scene.
WASHINGTON - Washington area firms were awarded a record $20.8 billion in federal contracts in fiscal 1996, government figures show.
WASHINGTON - Ambitious new Virginia state education standards are making teachers scramble to rejig their lesson plans.
WASHINGTON - Investigators are still trying to determine whether Montgomery County accountant Gaye Fister was killed or died by her own hand in a suicide designed to look like a mafia murder.
